label: PF Backlog 553
title: CI3: core/write_safety.py file_lock uses Windows-only msvcrt -> POSIX fcntl (Linux CI NameError)
body:
## Problem
`core/write_safety.py:65` calls `msvcrt.locking` unconditionally; on Linux `msvcrt` isn't imported (only `fcntl`) -> `NameError: name 'msvcrt' is not defined` -> test_write_safety fails in CI.
## Fix
Make `file_lock` platform-aware: msvcrt on Windows, `fcntl.flock` on POSIX.
## Acceptance
test_write_safety (safe_update_json/safe_append_json) passes on Linux.
